aboutMe.description:
I have built websites with React and mobile apps with React Native, visited from different places around the world, like the one you're visiting right now or my own app Ez-PDF.

With the 5 years of experience I have as a Developer, I decided to implement AI in an application built with React Native to make it easier for you to summarize PDF files.

I'm looking for my next challenge, one that will be of {{region}} caliber, building applications with the best practices every project deserves, like clean code, CI/CD, or SOLID.
